messages:
maria: heads up — release CI is failing on the sample-app publish job after the typegen regen. changelog-bot auto-bumped minor, but the diff looks like a reorder (should be patch).

maria: logs show auth retry tests flaking too, probably unrelated but surfaced in same pipeline.

tom: pinging from infra — can you paste the failing log?

maria: here, gist of the error:
```
> npm run publish:sample-app
Error: TypeError: Cannot read property 'map' of undefined
 at generated/types/index.js:12
 at Object.<anonymous> (sample-app/dist/index.js:45)
```

maria: and the regendiff is tiny, mainly parameter ordering in generated client: `createUser(body, opts)` -> `createUser(opts, body)` (uhoh).

jen: who ran the regen originally? I saw a CI job that ran typegen with a new openapi schema from the swagger team earlier today.

sandeep: that change matches a schema tweak where `requestBody` got moved under a different path. It was intended to be non-breaking but codegen picked a different overload ordering.

aaron: this is classic nondeterministic codegen ordering. Our semver bot checks for "breaking" by looking at exported symbols + signature diffs, but it ignores parameter ordering for overload resolution — which our JS clients rely on.

maria: release-bot already bumped minor due to the semver check tripping on a change in the generated typing file (it saw new optional param). Can we revert the changelog bump to patch?

release-bot: changelog PR #1427 was created and labeled "minor" based on automated semver detection. To change, run `/release-bot adjust-level PR#1427 patch` or open a manual PR.

jen: quick options: 1) revert the typegen commit and rerun regen after fixing generator ordering; 2) accept minor and treat it as minor (ugly for downstream); 3) hotfix in sample-app to tolerate param reorder. Thoughts?

tom: prefer revert + fix generator. We should avoid churn for downstreams. Reverting is fastest if nothing else depends on the schema change.

sandeep: I'll check whether the schema tweak is actually needed. If it's optional we can roll back and open a tracked ticket with the swagger team.

aaron: also let's add a CI gate: when typegen changes are detected, run the sample-app smoke publish job against the generated package before letting release-bot pick a semver level. That would catch this early.

maria: +1 to the gate. Right now release-bot triggers earlier than the publish smoke. I've seen multiple false minors from semver heuristics.

jen: quick triage — for this release I'm going to manually adjust the changelog to patch to avoid bumping downstream expectations. sandeep can you revert the typegen commit and put the regen on a hotfix branch?

sandeep: will do. Pushing revert in 5.

ci-bot: build 2170002468.2 started for sample-app (revert-typegen).

maria: awesome. Also follow-up: can we add an auth/retry unit that stubs out transient 429/503 behavior? Auth retry flakiness surfaced in the same run and made debugging noisy.

aaron: yes, add a deterministic retry test harness and mark it as flaky-guard in CI so unrelated flakes don't fail the whole pipeline. I'll draft a spec.

jen: noted. After revert lands and smoke publish passes, I'll cut a patch release and update the changelog. We should also add a short note in the release checklist: "verify SDK parity in sample apps after typegen regen".

maria: thanks all. sandeep — ping here when revert PR links are ready. If smoke publish passes, I'll run `/release-bot adjust-level PR#1427 patch` to correct the changelog entry.

sandeep: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/311 (revert typegen). CI passing so far.

ci-bot: build 2170002468.2 passed — smoke publish succeeded.

maria: adjusted. release-bot updated changelog to patch. :tada:

aaron: follow-ups: (1) add pre-release smoke publish gate for typegen changes; (2) add a small deterministic auth/retry test harness; (3) file a generator bug to prefer stable overload ordering. I'll create tickets.

jen: I'll add the checklist item to the release playbook and tweak the semver heuristics doc to be less eager.

maria: thanks team. Closing this thread once release artifacts are cut.

release-bot: release artifacts for v1.8.2 (patch) created and uploaded.
